name: Ethereum
description: Ethereum is a public blockchain launched in 2015 by a multi-person founding team.

walletReview.notes: No current founder-controlled wallet was established from reviewed evidence.

fundingReview.notes: The disclosed crowdsale amount is approximate, so the reviewed ledger is not sufficient for ranking.

methodologyNotes: Research-only and unranked. Primary sources establish the founding team, crowdsale, and genesis allocation, but do not attribute current founder-controlled wallets. No wallet row or zero balance is inferred. The crowdsale is excluded from capital deduction because the reviewed source states only an approximate historical USD value.

name: Uniswap
description: Uniswap is an Ethereum protocol created by Hayden Adams; UNI is its governance token.

walletReview.notes: No current founder-controlled wallet was established from reviewed evidence.

fundingReview.notes: Two priced rounds are verified, but an earlier seed investment remains unresolved.

methodologyNotes: Research-only and unranked. Official sources document the founder, UNI allocation, contract, and two funding rounds, but allocation categories do not attribute a current founder-controlled wallet. No wallet row or zero balance is inferred. An earlier seed investment is acknowledged without a reviewed primary-source amount, so funding completeness is unresolved.

name: Solana
description: Solana is a public blockchain developed by a founding team assembled around Solana Labs.

walletReview.notes: No current founder-controlled wallet was established from reviewed evidence.

fundingReview.notes: The 2021 private sale is verified, but the lifetime outside-capital ledger remains incomplete.

methodologyNotes: Research-only and unranked. Official sources document the founding history, token-supply context, and a material private token sale, but do not attribute a current founder-controlled SOL wallet or establish a complete lifetime funding ledger. Foundation, company, market-making, and other allocation categories are not treated as founder property. No wallet row or zero balance is inferred.
